children: LiqTech International Inc. (LIQT) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 08, 2026.

On August 31, 2026, David Noerby Foss Kowalczyk, the Chief Financial and Operating Officer of LiqTech International, Inc. (the "Company"), notified the Company of his intention to resign effective November 30, 2026. Mr. Kowalczyk's departure is not the result of any disagreement between Mr. Kowalczyk and the Company on any matter relating to the Company's operations, policies or practices.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1307579/000143774926029823/liqt20260904_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1307579/000143774926029823/0001437749-26-029823-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
